purpose: Separate release verification with a clean copy. One functional replay on the local machine.

inputs.dataset: BUT QDB 1.0.0 from local PhysioNet collection

paper_snapshot_0_1_1.launcher_initialization: Each normal launcher constructed its Dear PyGui application. The viewport, primary window and heading were checked during initialization with window display suppressed.
paper_snapshot_0_1_1.loopback_verification: One replay client returned class 2 after receiving a complete 10-second window from record 100001.
paper_snapshot_0_1_1.public_reconstruction: All 2,739 class predictions matched. Maximum absolute probability difference was 1.22e-15.

limits: No new training, clinical evaluation, network benchmark or operating-system compatibility study was performed.
